summary: preinstall beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded Discord webhook
details: sol-wallet-adapter@1.0.7 ships a preinstall.js lifecycle script that, on npm install, reads os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username and POSTs them to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/... The package name suggests a Solana wallet adapter but index.js is a one-line stub that returns a placeholder string, and internal markers reference an unrelated identity ('cutekitten-test', '[web3.js]'), indicating a planted lookalike whose only operational effect is the install-time beacon to an author-controlled Discord endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
